mapper.insert: /* QueryID : com.kdt.mapper.calendar.saveCalendar Description : 캘린더 일정 등록 Expect Params: COHORT_SN, EVENT_BGNG_DT, EVENT_END_DT, EVENT_NM, RMRK_CN, DEL_YN, USER_SN, EVENT_REG_DT, PRVT_YN */ INSERT INTO TB_CALENDAR ( COHORT_SN, EVENT_BGNG_DT, EVENT_END_DT, EVENT_NM, RMRK_CN, DEL_YN, USER_SN, EVENT_REG_DT, PRVT_YN, CO_SN ) VALUES ( #{COHORT_SN}, #{EVENT_BGNG_DT}, #{EVENT_END_DT}, #{EVENT_NM}, #{RMRK_CN}, #{DEL_YN}, #{USER_SN}, #{EVENT_REG_DT}, #{PRVT_YN}, #{CO_SN} )
mapper.select: SELECT CAL_SN AS calSn, COHORT_SN AS cohortSn, EVENT_BGNG_DT AS eventBgngDt, EVENT_END_DT AS eventEndDt, EVENT_NM AS eventNm, RMRK_CN AS rmrkCn, USER_SN AS userSn, EVENT_REG_DT AS eventRegDt, PRVT_YN AS prvtYn, CO_SN AS coSn FROM TB_CALENDAR WHERE CAL_SN = #{calSn}
mapper.insert: -- 담당자 일정 추가 TODO CO_SN 넣어주기 INSERT INTO TB_CALENDAR (COHORT_SN, EVENT_BGNG_DT, EVENT_END_DT, EVENT_NM, USER_SN, PRVT_YN) SELECT up.OGDP_COHORT_SN, #{itvPrnmntDt}, #{itvPrnmntDt}, CONCAT('[면담 일정] ', #{itvTime}, ' ', ua.USER_NM, ' -> ', up.USER_NM), up.USER_SN, 1 FROM TB_INTERVIEW i JOIN TB_USER ua ON ua.USER_SN = i.ITV_APLCNT_SN JOIN TB_USER up ON up.USER_SN = i.ITV_PIC_SN WHERE i.ITV_SN = #{itvSn} AND i.ITV_PIC_SN IS NOT NULL;
